cues: Maize, sugarcane, and our own kodo millet and latte have a fix.
Cut a leaf across and you see Kranz anatomy, from the German for wreath.
Each vein is wrapped in a ring of large bundle-sheath cells packed with chloroplasts, and around those, a ring of mesophyll cells.
